The FX feed and `FxRateBook` are integrated and running in the regenerated processor. The existing price processing produces the same business records as before. One limitation: the analyser chart plots all four pairs on one axis, not EURUSD alone.

- `src/main/fluxtion/designer/application-context.xml`
